name: Seasonal Jobs at Lagoon Amusement Park
what_you_do: Lagoon hires seasonal staff for its park. The job list has many kinds of jobs. Each job post names the duties.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 14 when you finish the application. Some jobs have other age rules. You need a valid email address.
pay_detail: Pay is called competitive. The rate is not stated on the program page.
duration: Seasonal. Dates are not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page. The page still says it is hiring for the 2024 season, so call to confirm the current year.
how_to_apply: Fill out one online application. List other jobs you would take as backups. Read the employee rules before you apply. You can call Employee Services at 801-451-8058 for help.
notes: Lagoon is in Farmington, Utah. Perks include free entry to Lagoon Family Days and park store discounts. The park uses E-Verify to check work eligibility. A separate job page covers the fall Frightmares season.
